nora (devex): heads-up: sample-app in monorepo fails in our edge dev server after upgrading pnpm. error: "The requested module '@redwood/sdk' does not provide an export named 'createClient'"

nora (devex): using pnpm 8.6, node 18.17, workspace symlink. package.json for sdk has exports only for ./dist/esm/index.mjs, no root '.' mapping.

ken (eng-runtime): that explains it. bundlers and Node resolve the package root; if '.' isn't exported, import/require can break. show me the sdk package.json?

nora (devex): snippet: name @redwood/sdk, exports: { "./dist/esm/index.mjs": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "./package.json": "./package.json" }

ish (eng-ml): also watch types — TS sometimes ignores conditional exports. ensure top-level "types":"dist/index.d.ts" so editors find declarations in workspace mode.

alex (devex): edge wants native ESM. Add an exports['.'] with import -> esm and require -> cjs to support legacy. Example: ".": { "import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }

ken (eng-runtime): note: if you add require mapping, some bundlers might pick cjs and then include it into an esm bundle causing runtime "exports is not defined". For edge examples prefer import-only.

nora (devex): workaround: changed sample-app to `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.mjs'` and it works locally. ugly but unblocks CI.

ish (eng-ml): long-term: update SDK pkg, add CI smoke that builds sample-app as workspace consumer (symlink) with node 18 + edge bundler. catches regressions.

alex (devex): I'll add a short devex note about pnpm symlink pitfalls (clear pnpm store, rebuild d.ts, preserve-symlinks debugging) and update sample-app docs to prefer ESM imports for edge.

ci-bot: created issue #1248: add exports root mapping + workspace edge smoke test. queued small pipeline job.

nora (devex): opening PR to adjust package.json and add a test. will include reproduction steps and logs. thanks :pray:
